messages:
ivy-sales: Quick prep for Wed call w/ EuroTrust. Asks: EU-only processing, BYOK (customer KMS), signed subprocessor list, and a routing policy that prevents cross-border failover. Need a 45s script + ops checklist.

marco-presales: TL;DR: Hosted = regional preference, not strict. Dedicated or Private required for hard pinning + BYOK. I'll keep it short on the call.

leah-eng: Hosted detail: we prefer EU regions but may route to another region on capacity/DR. Dedicated: can allocate a single-region reserved pool (eu-west1 or eu-central1) and disable cross-region fallback. Private: full customer control. BYOK: supported on Dedicated/Private; onboarding includes key registration, policy validation, and test decrypts.

oscar-legal: EU subprocessors we regularly use: LogSafe (logging), Observr (metrics), CloudGX (infra). We can provide a DPA and an up-to-date subprocessor attestation; for strict customers we offer a signed attestation add-on. Avoid absolute "never" language for Hosted.

ivy-sales: Need two conservative lines I can read (Hosted, Dedicated) and a one-line KMS timeline.

leah-eng: Hosted (conservative): "Redwood processes customer workloads primarily in EU regions; in exceptional capacity or recovery events requests may be routed to a compatible region; Redwood will notify the customer and provide remediation options."

leah-eng: Dedicated (conservative): "Redwood will provision dedicated capacity in the customer-specified EU region and operate with region-pinning; data processing and storage will remain in that region except for minimal control-plane metadata required for platform operation and auditing."

leah-eng: KMS onboarding: typically 7-21 days (key exchange, policy review, test flows). Private/on-prem deployments take longer (4-6 weeks).

nora-pricing: Ballpark for procurement: one-time setup ~$36k, committed monthly for a 2x A100 dedicated pool ~$17k/mo, BYOK & signed attestation add-on ~$5k/yr. Final quote depends on throughput and retention.

peter-ops: Ops handoff checklist (I'll create ticket PROJ-55001): 1) Confirm EU region selection 2) Collect KMS key IDs + rotation policy + allowlist CIDRs 3) Deliver subprocessor attestation + DPA timeline 4) Egress cert fingerprints & rotation cadence 5) Audit log export & retention 6) SLA expectations/runbook and failure modes.

iv y-sales: Can we show a tiny example routing policy for "pin to region" so customer sees concrete config?

leah-eng: Sample (Dedicated strict pin):

```
{"routing": {"mode": "pin", "region": "eu-west1", "fallback": "none"}}
```

leah-eng: Note: fallback:"none" not available for Hosted (Hosted uses "preference").

task-bot: Ticket PROJ-55001 created and assigned to @peter-ops.

ivy-sales: Perfect 94 will use the lines, pricing, timeline, and promise PROJ-55001 follow-up. I'll post any redlines after the call. :thumbsup:
